name: sparql_endpoints
description: A queryable endpoint (nfdi:NFDI_0001095) is modelled as a part of the dataset it serves, linked with obo:BFO_0000051 (has part), rather than as a property of the dataset. This keeps the endpoint addressable and separately describable.
competency_questions: Which SPARQL endpoints can the MatWerk Knowledge Graph be federated with?; What is the endpoint URL of a given knowledge graph, and under which licence is it offered?; Who created and maintains a given endpoint's dataset?
